import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXT = 65;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;
        Edge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int N;
        ArrayList<Edge> E;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> adj;
        int[] dist, ptr;

        Dinic(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            E = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>(N);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            dist = new int[N];
            ptr = new int[N];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            if (u == v) return;
            E.add(new Edge(u, v, cap));
            adj.get(u).add(E.size() - 1);
            E.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(E.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs(int S, int T) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, N + 1);
            dist[S] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(S);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == T) break;
                for (int idx : adj.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = E.get(idx);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.v] > dist[e.u] + 1) {
                        dist[e.v] = dist[e.u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[T] != N + 1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, int T, long flow) {
            if (u == T || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (; ptr[u] < adj.get(u).size(); ptr[u]++) {
                int idx = adj.get(u).get(ptr[u]);
                Edge e = E.get(idx);
                Edge oe = E.get(idx ^ 1);
                if (dist[e.v] == dist[e.u] + 1) {
                    long amt = e.cap - e.flow;
                    if (flow != -1 && amt > flow) amt = flow;
                    long pushed = dfs(e.v, T, amt);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        oe.flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow(int S, int T) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(S, T)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long flow;
                while ((flow = dfs(S, T, -1)) > 0) {
                    total += flow;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        char[][] s1 = new char[n + 2][n + 2];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                s1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        int[][][] idMap = new int[t + 2][n + 2][n + 2];
        int curId = 1;
        for (int time = 0; time <= t + 1; time++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    idMap[time][i][j] = curId++;
                }
            }
        }
        int source = 0;
        int sink = curId;
        curId++;

        char[][] s2 = new char[n + 2][n + 2];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                s2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        int[][] dp = new int[n + 2][n + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) Arrays.fill(dp[i], -1);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    dp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] dy = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
        int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int uy = cur[0], ux = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int vy = uy + dy[d];
                int vx = ux + dx[d];
                if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && s1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && dp[vy][vx] == -1) {
                    dp[vy][vx] = dp[uy][ux] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{vy, vx});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (dp[i][j] == -1 || dp[i][j] > t) dp[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(curId);

        // source edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] >= '1' && s1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    dinic.addEdge(source, idMap[0][i][j], s1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        // neighbor list (per row, as in original code)
        ArrayList<ArrayList<int[]>> neigh = new ArrayList<>(n + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) neigh.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int vy = i + dy[d];
                    int vx = j + dx[d];
                    if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && s1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && s1[vy][vx] != 'Z') {
                        neigh.get(i).add(new int[]{vy, vx});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // time edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Y' || s1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int[] nb : neigh.get(i)) {
                    int vy = nb[0], vx = nb[1];
                    for (int x = 0; x < t; x++) {
                        if (dp[vy][vx] >= x + 1 && dp[i][j] > x) {
                            dinic.addEdge(idMap[x][i][j], idMap[x + 1][vy][vx], 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // sink edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Y' || s1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                if (s2[i][j] >= '1' && s2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int cap = s2[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int x = 0; x <= t; x++) {
                        dinic.addEdge(idMap[x][i][j], idMap[t + 1][i][j], cap);
                    }
                    dinic.addEdge(idMap[t + 1][i][j], sink, cap);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow(source, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
